record.name: Threads (Meta)
record.one_liner: Official Meta API for publishing posts, retrieving media and profiles, managing replies, and viewing insights on Threads.
record.access_note: Developers create a Meta app with the Threads use case for free, though production access requires App Review.
record.api_note: Covers posting, profile retrieval, media fetching, reply moderation, and insights.
record.blocker_note: App review is required before users without a role on your app can grant permissions for production use.

evidence.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
To access the Threads API, create an app and pick the Threads Use Case.
Use the Threads API to create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights.
No. Meta has not shipped an MCP server for Threads, and the third-party ecosystem is very thin
